# Introduction

# Results

#| label: fig-example

library(ggplot2)

systemfonts::register_variant(
  name = "Libertinus Normal",
  family = "Libertinus Sans",
  weight = "normal"
)

ggplot(pressure, aes(temperature, pressure)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Libertinus Normal"))
